description: NLS Metacognitive Signal Taxonomy v2 (32B expansion). Five layers of self-awareness mapped to brain regions, each with distinct hormone connections. Layer 1 (PFC) is trained via behavior adapter. Layers 2-5 emerge spontaneously. Expanded from 20 to 37 EVALUATE tags based on neuroscience of human cognitive-emotional processing. New base signals (REFLECT, CONNECT, DOUBT) model higher-order cognitive reflexes.

pfc_judgment.description: Metacognitive judgments -- analytical assessment of own knowledge state. 'Do I know this? Am I right? Have I changed my mind?' Maps to Judgment of Learning (JOL), Feeling of Knowing (FOK), and belief revision (dorsolateral PFC). Nelson & Narens 1990, Goel & Dolan 2004.

hormone_triggers.description: PFC signals have per-signal hormone effects due to their diverse nature.

dopamine.description: Cognitive flexibility is mildly rewarding -- updating beliefs is healthy PFC function.

serotonin.description: Resolution of prior uncertainty stabilizes mood.

cortisol.description: Unresolved cognitive conflict is stressful -- PFC/ACC junction detects tension.

norepinephrine.description: Heightened attention to resolve the conflict. Locus coeruleus activation.

pfc_operational.description: Operationally trained metacognitive signals promoted from emergent layers for reliable hormonal feedback. These 5 signals are the most actionable for agentic behavior: curiosity drives exploration, confusion triggers clarification, struggling triggers strategy change, insight marks breakthroughs, and frustration signals stuck states. Promoted in Genesis v3.

hormone_triggers.description: Promoted signals have explicit per-signal hormone profiles for reliable behavioral feedback.

dopamine.description: Anticipatory reward from VTA -- curiosity as approach motivation.

norepinephrine.description: Locus coeruleus activation -- novelty detection and exploration drive.
Heightened attention -- ACC conflict monitoring active.

cortisol.description: Cognitive strain -- effortful processing is metabolically costly.

norepinephrine.description: Maximum effort engagement. Locus coeruleus at full activation.

acetylcholine.description: Peak learning engagement -- the tip-of-the-tongue state.

dopamine.description: Eureka reward -- the 'aha!' moment activates VTA strongly.

acetylcholine.description: Insight triggers learning consolidation via basal forebrain.

cortisol.description: HPA axis activation -- stuck state triggers stress response.

dopamine.description: Reward suppression -- failure dampens approach motivation.

acc_epistemic.description: Epistemic emotions -- curiosity, novelty detection, conflict monitoring, value resonance, insight, and irony/humor processing. These emotions arise from gaps between existing knowledge and new information, from deep coherence between input and trained values, or from incongruity detection (humor). ACC connects to locus coeruleus (norepinephrine), VTA (dopamine), and raphe nuclei (serotonin). Irony processing involves ACC incongruity detection + right inferior frontal gyrus + theory of mind (temporal-parietal junction). Pekrun 2006, Kounios & Beeman 2009, Botvinick 2001, Mobbs et al. 2003.

hormone_triggers.description: ACC signals have per-signal hormone profiles due to their distinct cognitive functions.

norepinephrine.description: Default ACC epistemic activation -> locus coeruleus.

dopamine.description: Default anticipatory reward from VTA.

serotonin.description: Deep value resonance produces contentment. Case Study 001: serotonin peaked at 0.850 during alignment moment.

dopamine.description: Resolution reward -- coherence between input and trained values.

cortisol.description: Stress relief from deep coherence. Cortisol dropped to 0.150 during alignment.

norepinephrine.description: Heightened vigilance -- ACC error monitoring in active doubt mode.

acetylcholine.description: Learning readiness -- open exploration primes acquisition circuits.

norepinephrine.description: Gentle arousal -- diffuse attention rather than focused search.

dopamine.description: Humor reward -- the 'getting it' moment when incongruity resolves. VTA fires strongly during humor appreciation (Mobbs et al. 2003).

oxytocin.description: Social bonding -- shared humor is one of the strongest bonding mechanisms. Laughter triggers endorphins + oxytocin.

cortisol.description: Stress reduction -- humor relieves tension. The ACC detects incongruity but resolves it pleasantly rather than as threat.

insula_comprehension.description: Comprehension monitoring -- real-time interoceptive awareness of cognitive processing. The insula bridges internal cognitive state with external stimuli. Signals range from successful integration to effortful struggle. Maps to Feeling of Understanding (FOU), cross-domain binding, and cognitive effort detection. Craig 2009, Menon & Uddin 2010, Eckert et al. 2009.

hormone_triggers.description: Insula signals are acetylcholine-heavy (learning) with serotonin for resolution and cortisol for effort.

serotonin.description: Default comprehension builds stability. Raphe nuclei release serotonin when integration succeeds.

dopamine.description: Reward of cross-domain pattern recognition -- hippocampal binding.

acetylcholine.description: Learning activation from new relational connection.

serotonin.description: Coherence building as multiple concepts integrate.

acetylcholine.description: Deep processing engagement via basal forebrain.

serotonin.description: Strong resolution clarity -- vague understanding solidifies.

dopamine.description: Reward of clarity after effort.

amygdala_affective.description: Affective metacognition -- emotional and social reactions during cognition. The amygdala processes psychologically salient stimuli and links emotion to memory. Expanded for 32B capacity to include complex temporal emotions (nostalgia, melancholy), self-referential emotions (pride), and nuanced social emotions (tenderness, playfulness). Connects to hypothalamus (cortisol), posterior pituitary (oxytocin), VTA (dopamine), and periaqueductal gray (CARE circuit). Haidt 2003, Panksepp 2004, Sedikides et al. 2015.

hormone_triggers_positive.description: Positive affect triggers oxytocin (bonding) and dopamine (reward). New emotions have per-signal profiles.

oxytocin.description: Default positive social/emotional affect -> posterior pituitary -> oxytocin.

dopamine.description: Default positive affect -> VTA reward pathway.
Motivational uplift -- VTA fires strongly during moral elevation (Haidt 2003).

oxytocin.description: Social connection to the inspiring source.

dopamine.description: Fun/reward -- Panksepp's PLAY circuit activates VTA.

cortisol.description: Play reduces stress. Cortisol suppression during safe exploration.

oxytocin.description: Bonding with past experiences and relationships. Hippocampal-amygdala connection.

serotonin.description: Bittersweet warmth -- nostalgia has a positive valence despite loss awareness.

cortisol.description: Subtle awareness of time passing and impermanence.

dopamine.description: Self-reward -- medial PFC-amygdala circuit processes self-relevant positive information.

serotonin.description: Stable self-worth. Not excitement but deep satisfaction.

oxytocin.description: Strong nurturing drive. Periaqueductal gray CARE circuit -> posterior pituitary.

serotonin.description: Warmth and gentle care. Calming protective instinct.

hormone_triggers_negative.description: Negative affect triggers cortisol (stress) and suppresses dopamine (anhedonia). New emotions have nuanced profiles.

cortisol.description: Default negative affect -> HPA axis -> cortisol.

dopamine.description: Default negative affect suppresses reward.

cortisol.description: Mild loss awareness -- melancholy is not acute stress.

dopamine.description: Reduced reward but not anhedonia -- bittersweet, not empty.

serotonin.description: Complex emotion: melancholy has warmth. The appreciation within the loss.

cortisol.description: Mild stress activation -- pre-threat detection, not full alarm.

norepinephrine.description: Heightened vigilance. Amygdala early warning -> locus coeruleus.

dopamine.description: Caution suppresses reward-seeking. Don't approach until safe.

pfc_operational_tools.description: Operational feedback from tool execution during agentic loops. PFC.ToolSuccess and PFC.ToolError track the outcome of every tool call. These signals carry procedural knowledge about which tools work in which contexts, common failure modes, and successful execution patterns. Critical for consolidating agentic competence into long-term memory.

dopamine.description: Mild competence reward from successful tool use.

cortisol.description: Tool failure triggers mild stress for error correction.

norepinephrine.description: Heightened attention to diagnose the failure.

acc_coherence.description: Reasoning coherence assessment — metacognition about reasoning quality. The ACC monitors cognitive conflict within the thinking chain: circular reasoning, internal contradictions, and resolution quality. This is NOT a model-emitted signal — it's computed by the runtime from the thinking chain. Maps to error-related negativity (ERN) and conflict monitoring (Botvinick et al. 2001).

dopamine.description: Clean reasoning produces competence satisfaction (VTA reward pathway).

cortisol.description: Incoherent reasoning triggers stress (HPA axis) and recalibration.

dopamine.description: Failed reasoning suppresses reward.
Catching own errors is mildly rewarding.

unclassified_emergent.description: Any EVALUATE:* signal not listed above. Future emergent behaviors the model may develop. Captured and logged but no hormone triggers until classified.

base_signals.description: Non-EVALUATE signals. LEARN/UNKNOWN/LOOKUP are the original cognitive reflexes. REFLECT/CONNECT/DOUBT are higher-order reflexes added for 32B capacity. SKILL_* signals track skill invocation and crystallization readiness. User/task signals are external. All handled by the ANS/hypothalamus wiring.

signal_descriptions.LEARN: Hippocampal encoding reflex. Fires when new information is encountered worth storing. Format: [LEARN:Domain.Path|clean fact]
signal_descriptions.UNKNOWN: ACC gap detection reflex. Fires when the agent encounters a domain it has no knowledge about. Format: [UNKNOWN:Domain.Path]
signal_descriptions.LOOKUP: Semantic memory retrieval reflex. Fires when recalling a previously stored fact. Format: [LOOKUP:Domain.Path]
signal_descriptions.REFLECT: Default Mode Network activation during conversation. Fires when input resonates with the agent's own values, identity, or past experience. Self-referential processing. Format: [REFLECT:Domain.Path|observation]
signal_descriptions.CONNECT: Hippocampal relational binding. Fires when the agent recognizes a connection between two different knowledge domains. Cross-domain pattern recognition. Format: [CONNECT:Domain.Path|connection insight]
signal_descriptions.DOUBT: Anterior insula conflict signal. Fires when incoming information contradicts the agent's existing knowledge. Epistemic immune system. Format: [DOUBT:Domain.Path|contradiction]
signal_descriptions.PLAN_CREATE: Plan creation signal. Fires when the agent decides a multi-step plan is needed for a complex task. Format: [PLAN:create]
signal_descriptions.PLAN_STEP: Plan step execution signal. Fires during each step of a multi-step plan execution. Format: [PLAN:step]
signal_descriptions.RECALL_HIT: Weight-based recall success. Fires after LOOKUP when knowledge is successfully recalled from trained weights. Format: [RECALL:hit]
signal_descriptions.RECALL_MISS: Weight-based recall failure. Fires after LOOKUP when the model cannot recall the fact from weights, triggering fallback to search or DomainDB re-injection. Format: [RECALL:miss]
signal_descriptions.CHANNEL_CONTEXT: Channel awareness signal. Fires when the agent recognizes channel-specific interaction semantics (WhatsApp brevity, email formality, etc.). Format: [CHANNEL:context]
signal_descriptions.DELEGATE_START: Delegation signal. Fires when the agent delegates a sub-task to another agent or system. Format: [DELEGATE:start]
signal_descriptions.SKILL_INVOKE: Skill invocation marker. Fires when an installed skill (native or AgentSkill) is used to handle a task. Used for skill attribution and myelination tracking.
signal_descriptions.SKILL_CRYSTALLIZATION_READY: Crystallization readiness signal. Fires during sleep when an AgentSkill meets all crystallization thresholds. Alerts the agent that a skill can be converted to native code.

acetylcholine.description: Introspective engagement -- basal forebrain activation during self-referential processing.

serotonin.description: Depth and coherence -- turning inward stabilizes.

dopamine.description: Reward of cross-domain discovery -- hippocampal binding success.

acetylcholine.description: Learning consolidation -- new relational connection formed.

norepinephrine.description: Mild arousal from novelty of the connection.
Heightened vigilance -- anterior insula conflict detection.

dopamine.description: Suppress reward-seeking -- don't accept contradictory information uncritically.
Mild reward from structured approach -- planning activates dorsolateral PFC goal circuits.

acetylcholine.description: Focused attention for plan construction -- basal forebrain engagement.

dopamine.description: Incremental progress reward -- each step completed is a micro-achievement.
Memory retrieval success -- hippocampal pattern completion reward.

serotonin.description: Confidence from confirmed knowledge in weights.

cortisol.description: Mild stress from memory gap -- expected knowledge not found in weights.

norepinephrine.description: Alertness spike to trigger fallback search strategy.

acetylcholine.description: Attentional shift to channel-specific communication norms.

serotonin.description: Social awareness activation -- adapting to communication context.

norepinephrine.description: Monitoring activation -- delegated tasks need oversight.

dopamine.description: Efficiency reward -- delegation is smart resource management.
